name: Sudipta Mishra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sudipta Mishra writes poetry and essays and has a background in dance and other arts. Her collection The Essence of Life, published by Notion Press, addresses social questions including inequality, gender discrimination and environmental concerns. Her poetry publications include The Songs of My Heart.

The poems gathered in Kabita Live return to the distance between outward appearance and inner experience. In ‘Pain’, a smile conceals anger and injury; in ‘An Escape’, successive declarations of need, desire and hope seek release from suffering. ‘In The Realm Of Permanence’ imagines blossoms, stars and a timeless world beyond everyday distractions. Together, these works explore the longing for a peace that ordinary life does not readily offer.
